newsitem.title: USA: Paracelsus slapped with class action suit.
newsitem.headline: Paracelsus slapped with class action suit.

text.p: A shareholder class action lawsuit against Paracelsus Healthcare Corp has been filed in Los Angeles County Superior Court, lawyers for the plaintiffs said.

The company and its officers and directors are charged with making false and misleading financial statements in connection with the company's acquisition of Champion Healthcare Corp, and the issuue of stock and debt related to the takeover, the attorneys said.
The suit follows an October 9 announcement by the company that its financial results for the quarter ended September 30 would be substantially lower than expected.
The news release also said the company expected to restate its financial results for the quarters ended December 31, March 31 and June 30.
Plaintiffs are represented by three law firms, Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP, Kaplan, Kilsheimer & Fox LLP and Savett Frutkin Podell & Ryan PC.
